resources.string: Type your betting site\'s address above, or add it in the predictor\'s Settings below. You sign in to the site yourself; Colon JetX never sees or keeps your password.
Enter a web address, such as example.com
AI mode: Colon bets only when the analysis says BET and your guardrails are clear. Demo bets are never clicked. Not a guarantee: tap STOP any time.
Shared mode: when the analysis says BET, Colon asks you to confirm each bet with one tap. Not a guarantee: tap STOP any time.

Colon\'s suggestions are not guaranteed predictions. At about 97% RTP each bet loses about 3% of its stake on average, and no pattern changes that. Letting an app click for you may breach your betting site\'s terms. Colon will only click when your account is out of demo mode, the analysis says BET and every guardrail is clear. Only stake what you can afford to lose.
